briefs.title: Stocks slide as Nvidia, China chip curbs hit tech; oil falls on Mideast supply
briefs.summary: U.S. stocks fell sharply, with the S&P 500 down 1.9% and the Nasdaq down 2.5%, as AI and chip shares sold off ahead of Nvidia's earnings. The VIX rose 18.7% to 22.9. Oil dropped 3.9% and Treasury yields slipped.
